How to use

Refer to the included instruction manual for step-by-step guidance on assembling the layout set. Handle the plastic components carefully during assembly and place the layout on a stable surface for display.

Care instructions

Store the layout set components in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight to prevent warping or discoloration. Keep all small parts organized to avoid loss. Handle miniature accessories gently to maintain their condition. Clean dust off the assembled layout regularly with a soft brush or cloth to preserve its appearance.
